//: What `next build` type-checks (next.config.ts, typescript.tsconfigPath): the app without its tests.
The build checks with TypeScript 6 inside Node's 4GB, and the whole tree with its tests reached that limit:
it ran out of memory on 7 November 2026 when Services added about 1% to it. The deploy's Docker build never had
the tests (.dockerignore leaves them out), so this checks locally what the deploy checks. Tests ship nothing, and
`npm run typecheck` (TypeScript 7) still checks every file, tests included, on every push and before each deploy.
Keep `exclude` in step with tsconfig.json's: an extended file's own list replaces it.
